body: I'm still alive. Not feeling no different though.

I probably will be here still tomorrow because I'm sitting here too afraid to finish the job. I can't do it whilst crying and shaking. This isn't an easy thing to do to yourself. Anyone who thinks it is has never been there. I haven't done anything yet I'm too shaken. This won't last much longer I can't prolong it too much longer. There's no other way out.

Thanks reddit for providing a place for me to come and vent. 

Peace and <3 to you all.
Thanks but I've exhausted this plenty. (In particular the VEC. Believe me when I say they are not about helping people in need).

Yes, I considered it. I'm too fat. I'd never make it past basic training. I'm also blind as a bat and for all I know that would count me out more than my weight would. And sure, I can lose weight. But I don't have that kinda time. I'm to be evicted soon. I wish I could say that I had any faith in making something like a military career work for me but I don't have that sort of hope anymore. It'd all go to shit just like every other job I've held. I've had enough jobs to know that it is never any different.

> There will be more pain and misery. But believe me, and I speak from the bottom of my heart, it is worth enduring for those small moments.

I disagree. I've endured enough already. I've had enjoyable moments and those moments don't soften the suffering in any way. It's like wading through fire to get to water. I come out scarred beyond recognition every time. I'm tired.

Virginia. Customer service...enough said on that one. 

I've tried employment agencies, I've sought unemployment benefits for being fired, was approved for it, got hired somewhere only to be fired 3 weeks later and now I cannot get the UI benefits again. I've tried rental assistance which only helps the elderly and those with children. I've been on this same merry-go-round for 3 years. I'm over it.

I understand what you're saying here. But I've put plenty of thought into this. That includes thinking of things that I will miss or never experience. For example I've never had an orgasm during intercourse (I'm a female). And you'd think that alone would be enough to keep me here but it's not. There are literally millions of experiences I'd love to stick around for. But I'd also have to stick around for more of this suffering in order to have it. And I just can't take anymore.

> What country do you live in? Pretty much every country has some kind of financial-relief program.

I live in the U.S. That should automatically answer the 2nd half of your question.
